text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 86, September 03, 1947 ]
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 24, DATED NOVEMBER 12, 1946, ENTITLED “CREATING
THE NATIONAL ADVISORY HEALTH COUNCIL.”
The second paragraph of Executive Order No. 24, dated November 12, 1946, entitled “Creating the National
Advisory Health Council” is hereby amended to read as follows:
“NOW, THEREFORE, I, MANUEL ROXAS, President of the Philippines, by the powers vested in me by
law, do hereby create a body to be known as the National Advisory Health Council to study problems of
public health and sanitation and to make such recommendations as it may deem necessary for the
improvement of public health and sanitation and the promotion of medical research. The Council shall be
composed of the following:
The Secretary of Health and Public Welfare.............................................................................
Director, Bureau of Quarantine Service.....................................................................................
Chairman, Board of Medical Examiners....................................................................................
President, Philippine Medical Association.................................................................................
Dean, College of Medicine, University of the Philippines..........................................................
Dean, College of Medicine, University of Santo Tomas.............................................................
Dr. Florentino Herrera................................................................................................................
Dr. Pedro Velasco......................................................................................................................
Dr. Lorenzo Macaisa..................................................................................................................
Dr. Antonio Fernando.................................................................................................................
Dr. Guillermo Rustia...................................................................................................................
Dr. Agustin Liboro.......................................................................................................................
Dr. Fermin Caram.......................................................................................................................
Dr. Miguel Cañizares..................................................................................................................
